limitation.note: The public API behaves differently from v2 here. v2 returned one continuation token for the merged billing document list. The public OQ APIs have separate per-kind cursors; the v1 API uses a page-number URL that is not interchangeable with the v2 continuation token. For OQ, page each document kind independently using the nextPage cursor returned by that kind's operation. For v1, use the nextPage URL or the page integer parameter of Get_BillingDocuments. Neither approach produces a single merged cursor equivalent to the v2 next_page. No vetted GraphQL example is available.

response.mapping_hint: The public OQ route uses three independent cursors (one for invoices, one for credit memos, one for debit memos). Track each cursor separately; keep paginating a collection until its nextPage is absent or null.

target.transform: Read the v1 nextPage URL; it encodes the next page. To continue, either follow that URL directly with the same authentication and filters, or extract the page parameter value and pass it as the integer page parameter of the same operation. Do not use this URL as a cursor parameter; Get_BillingDocuments uses integer page and pageSize, not a cursor.
Adapt each returned row into the mapped v2 shape; row fields are mapped by their own entries

Invoice rows: if remaining_balance is non-nil and state is present, paid = remaining_balance === 0 && Status === "Posted" (the public Status value; v2 state posted and open both map to it); otherwise omit. Memo rows: if remaining_balance is non-nil, paid = remaining_balance === 0; otherwise omit

When due_date is set and paid is defined, past_due = new Date(due_date) < the current time of the system that evaluates it && !paid; otherwise omit. Recompute paid from the balance and the Status value using the paid transformation. Note: clock differences between systems can change the result when the due date is close to the current time.

unsupported.note: The public API behaves differently from v2 here. v2 filtered the merged billing document list by document type. The public OQ APIs provide separate operations per document type; the v1 API does not expose a document-type filter parameter. To retrieve only invoices, call the OQ queryInvoices operation. To retrieve only credit memos, call queryCreditMemos. To retrieve only debit memos, call queryDebitMemos. For v1, Get_BillingDocuments returns all document types together and has no document-type filter parameter. No vetted GraphQL example is available.

The public APIs do not accept this header. The v2 API accepted the x-custom-auth and zuora-cache-enabled request headers; neither header has a public equivalent. The billing documents list route did not wire a cache handler, so zuora-cache-enabled had no effect on this operation. The public APIs authenticate via a bearer token in the Authorization header and optionally accept zuora-entity-ids to scope the request to an entity and zuora-track-id for request tracing. Send the OAuth bearer token in the Authorization header. Pass zuora-entity-ids to scope the request to a specific entity, or zuora-track-id for request tracing. Do not send zuora-cache-enabled; the public APIs have no such header. No vetted GraphQL example is available.
